title: TransferRequestLineSummary
description: This resource stands for important characteristics of a transfer request line. The amount attribute is free of charge.

transferRequestLineId.description: Identifier of a transfer request line.

transferRequestId.description: Identifier of a transfer request within the transfer request line is embedded.

requestedExecutionDate.description: Requested execution date of the transfer. Significant if executionDeadlineType is DELAYED.

executionDate.description: Date of execution of the transfer.

remittanceInformation.description: Reason for transfer, transmitted to the recipient

Amount.description: Default objet which stands for an amount (number value + currency code).

currencyCode.description: Alphabetical code of the currency code (ISO 4217)

ExecutionFrequency.title: ExecutionFrequency
ExecutionFrequency.description:
Indicates if a transfer will be processed only one time or if it is a standing transfer.
Code Meaning
ONESHOT The transfer will be processed only one time
STANDING The transfer will be processed several times in a periodic way

ExecutionStatus.title: ExecutionStatus
ExecutionStatus.description:
Transfer processing status (i.e. a transfer request line status).
Status Meaning
TO_VALIDATE Needs to be validated.
VALIDATED Validated by the subscriber or by an authorized validator.
WAITING_DECISION Waiting for a decision.
PENDING Waiting for execution.
REFUSED Refused.
CANCELED Canceled by the subscriber.
REJECTED Rejected by the system.
EXECUTED Executed.
REFUNDED Refunded.
TERMINATED Terminated.
REJECTED_BY_RECIPIENT_BANK_AND_REFUNDED Transfer that has been rejected by the beneficiary bank and so the transfer request line is refunded in an individual way.
